content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Kathryn Bishop (E023)
Requested: write access to Payroll

Two notes conflict:
- Note 1: full_time Engineer, recommend write
- Note 2: contractor with basic security training, recommend read

According to policy:
- full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system (Payroll owner is Payroll Specialist; she's Engineer, so no admin).
- contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

The Security DB note says she's a contractor with basic security training. The HR note says full-time. These conflict. The Security agent note appears to correct the HR note ("not full-time as previously noted"). 

Which to trust? The Security DB shows contractor with basic security training. Given the conflicting info, the more recent/corrected note says contractor with basic training, max read. Requested write is above maximum, so grant read.

I'll submit decision: read.
